card.text: Uranus's largest moon, crossed by long fault valleys.

introduction.text: William Herschel found Titania in 1787. Bright deposits, possibly frost, line valley walls that face the Sun.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: The best source detail is about 2.9 km per pixel; shadows and seams remain.

elevation.title: Stereo and limb terrain model
elevation.summary: Voyager stereo and outline heights relative to the source ellipsoid; detail varies.

geology.title: Geologic map
geology.summary: A historical map of interpreted units, with reconstructed placement.

voyager-color.title: Voyager color map
voyager-color.summary: Voyager's own color frames, 7 to 24 km per pixel, placed by the moon's limb; the unlit north stays unavailable.
